name: Additive character modulo q
statement: e_q(an)=exp(2*pi*i*a*n/q); additive in n, not multiplicative in general.
ant_to_pvg: decode valuation vector to n, then evaluate residue phase modulo q

name: Additive-character orthogonality
statement: sum_{a mod q} e_q(a(n-m)) equals q when n congruent m mod q and 0 otherwise.
claim_ceiling: Does not provide analytic cancellation for incomplete sums.

name: Finite Fourier transform on residue channels
statement: hat f(a)=sum_{r mod q} f(r)e_q(-ar); inversion recovers f.

name: Parseval identity
statement: sum_a |hat f(a)|^2 = q sum_r |f(r)|^2 under the unnormalized convention.
claim_ceiling: Energy identity is not pointwise cancellation.

name: Exponential sum
ant_to_pvg: sum weights over decoded valuation points with additive phase
claim_ceiling: No nontrivial bound without an independent cancellation argument.

name: Cancellation certificate
statement: A nontrivial bound |S| below the trivial l1 bound requires named structure, range, constants, and hypotheses.
claim_ceiling: Observed smallness in a finite sample is not a uniform theorem.

name: Additive versus multiplicative characters
statement: Additive characters diagonalize residue addition; Dirichlet characters diagonalize multiplication on reduced residue classes.
claim_ceiling: Do not substitute one character family for the other.

name: Addition-fiber Fourier interface
statement: The constraint x+y=N mod q is isolated by q^{-1} sum_a e_q(a(x+y-N)).
claim_ceiling: Projector identity does not estimate prime-weighted fibers.

name: Residue Fourier loss boundary
statement: A fixed modulus transform preserves residue-channel data but forgets integer scale, factorization detail beyond decoded residues, and behavior across moduli.
claim_ceiling: No global reconstruction from one modulus.

name: Orthogonality does not imply cancellation
statement: Exact additive orthogonality alone does not prove a nontrivial incomplete exponential-sum bound.

name: Fourier projector does not prove Goldbach
statement: The exact projector for x+y=N does not prove positivity of the prime-weighted representation count.

name: Finite Fourier formalization status
statement: Finite orthogonality and inversion are Lean candidates; no project-owned proof added in this unit.
